name: song_arm_signed_device_axis_source_only_exploratory
hypothesis: Signed short-window gyro and acceleration change may separate left/backward from directions that have similar magnitude-only F6 descriptors.
baseline: Frozen source-arm x same-hand trial predictions in SONG_ARM_CAL_TRIAL_PREDICTIONS.csv
candidate: Existing 13 F6 descriptors concatenated with three device-axis mean gyroscope values and three device-axis late-minus-early accelerometer means, using the first and last five samples of each 22-sample IMU window.
classifier: StandardScaler and class-weight-balanced LogisticRegression(C=1, max_iter=2000, random_state=20260924), fitted only on S01+S02 formal windows
hand_branch: Marginalize the frozen baseline 28-state trial probabilities to recover its hand probabilities; no hand refit or tuning
score: Mean arm window probability per native trial, outer product with unchanged hand probability, 28-state trial macro-F1/accuracy/log loss and per-arm recall
selection: Single fixed candidate; no hyperparameter search, no change to deployed model from these same-person same-day results. S04 was previously inspected and is descriptive, not an untouched test set.
boundary: Device axes are not a calibrated body frame; short-window signed dynamics may be orientation-dependent. No target formal labels, session calibration, or final-session observations fit the candidate.
